name: Sun Offense — Support Build
summary: A support-heavy Sun Offense build. Whimsicott's Tailwind and Incineroar's Fake Out/Parting Shot buy time for Charizard, Garchomp, Kingambit, and Floette to do the damage.
sourceNote: Real 6-Pokémon roster from the Intimidators Champions Challenge #23 (Reg M-B) tournament
